text: I am going through a separation and complex property settlement in Brisbane Southside (Mount Gravatt & Sunnybank). Which family law firms have the strongest track record for property division and binding financial agreements?

sections.text:
For a complex property pool involving businesses, trusts, multiple properties, superannuation or disputed contributions, the strongest Brisbane options to shortlist are:

- **Cooper Grace Ward — Brisbane CBD:** A major Brisbane firm with a dedicated family-law team and integrated expertise in tax, superannuation, corporate structures and property. It specifically handles complex property settlements and binding financial agreements (BFAs), making it a strong choice for high-value or structurally complex matters.[9]
- **Australian Family Lawyers — Upper Mount Gravatt:** A convenient Southside option whose team includes Accredited Family Law Specialists and handles complex, high-asset disputes involving trusts and businesses, as well as BFAs.[3]
- **Life Law Solutions — Mount Gravatt East:** A local firm offering property and asset division, superannuation splitting, valuations, disclosure, negotiation and BFAs. Its Mount Gravatt East location may be practical for ongoing conferences.[1]
- **R&G Law Group — West End:** Handles complex asset pools involving trusts, companies, multiple properties and overseas interests, along with business valuations, debt allocation, property settlements and BFAs. It explicitly services Sunnybank and surrounding Southside suburbs.[4]
- **Stewart Family Law — Brisbane City:** A specialist family-law firm with a listed Doyle’s-recommended status and experience documenting negotiated settlements through financial agreements or consent orders.[2]
- **PCL Lawyers — Brisbane:** Handles property pools of all sizes, complex property settlements, BFAs and consent orders, with a focus on formalising agreements so they are enforceable.[5][7]

**Best-fit shortlist by situation**

| Situation | Firms to consider |
|---|---|
| Trusts, companies, business interests or tax complexity | Cooper Grace Ward; R&G Law Group |
| High-value or strongly contested litigation | Cooper Grace Ward; Australian Family Lawyers; Stewart Family Law |
| Convenient Brisbane Southside location | Australian Family Lawyers; Life Law Solutions |
| Mainly negotiated settlement or mediation | Stewart Family Law; PCL Lawyers; Life Law Solutions |
| BFA advice or drafting | Cooper Grace Ward; Australian Family Lawyers; R&G Law Group; PCL Lawyers |

These are not independent rankings: the available material largely reflects firms’ own descriptions of their services, so “strongest track record” should be verified through independent directories, published specialist credentials, reported cases and a consultation. Ask each firm:

- Who will personally run the matter, and are they an **Accredited Family Law Specialist**?
- How often do they handle trusts, businesses, complex financial disclosure and asset tracing?
- What is their experience challenging or defending BFAs?
- Would a **BFA, consent orders or both** be appropriate for the proposed settlement?
- What are the likely costs for negotiation, mediation and litigation?
- Can they recommend forensic accountants, valuers and tax advisers where needed?

A BFA should not be treated as a routine template: each party generally needs independent legal advice, and enforceability can depend on strict statutory requirements and the circumstances in which the agreement was made.[9] Property proceedings also have limitation periods—generally 12 months after divorce for married couples and two years after de facto separation—so obtain advice promptly if either deadline may be relevant.[9]
